text:
ana_pm: Quick thread: proposing 'Assured Lane' add-on — per-route reserved lane with a simple banded SKU and a 99p latency commitment. Need input on packaging, launch gates, and pilot terms.

kevin_eng: Feasible. Fast path: banded RPS buckets + proxy tag to route to tagged worker pools. Enforcement via token bucket; fallback = route to best-effort with explicit downgrade header. Estimate MVP for pilot ~8 weeks.

sam_sales: Field wants very simple pricing. Suggest bands: Lane-75, Lane-300, Lane-1200. Customers want a dashboard that shows reserved vs used to justify spend. Pilot asks for onboarding help.

rachel_ops: Ops concerns: noisy neighbors and exhaustion playbook. Recommend queue up to 200ms then fallback, plus alerts when reserved utilization < 30% for 14 days. Need runbook for exhausted pool incidents.

owen_fin: Bands are easiest to forecast. I'll model margins assuming 40%+ over incremental infra. Ask product to propose expected utilization rates per band.

mira_legal: Legal: define "reserved" precisely (soft reserve vs contractual bandwidth), list exclusions, and include a capped credit table. For pilots, use a short addendum limiting liability and allowing GA-term transition.

infra-bot: infra-bot: pushed assured-lane-proxy to staging at 2025-07-21T13:15Z, smoke checks ok.

ana_pm: Proposed launch gates: (1) 2 pilot customers signed, (2) staging SLO: 99p validated at 1.5x reserved load, (3) console shows per-lane metrics and invoice line-item, (4) legal pilot addendum approved, (5) ops runbook for exhaustion.

kevin_eng: Engineering checklist: API POST /assured/reserve {route, band, duration}; proxy honors lane tag; metrics: assured_reserved, assured_used, assured_downgraded; simple chaos test where reserved pool loses 25% capacity.

sam_sales: Pilot offer: 30% off first month + one SE migration day. I'll shortlist two pilot accounts and share today.

owen_fin: I'll deliver P&L bands by EOD Friday.

mira_legal: I'll draft pilot addendum and SLA bullets.

rachel_ops: I'll start a synthetic harness for exhaustion scenarios and the ops runbook.

ana_pm: Thanks — owners noted. Follow-up sync next Wed 10am PT. If any objections to gating, DM me. :thumbsup:
